notes: No misreadings found. Things a human reviewer may want to look at: (1) The evidence file disagrees with itself about remove. The older 'Additem guide evidence' bullet says the preview stayed after a click and after Enter, and the 29 × 29 remove button had no accessible name. The 8 October 2026 '636f3f5 check' says #188 is fixed. The entry follows the newer check, which looks right, but the stale bullet could mislead later extractions. (2) /accessibility/0 says 'a click, a tap or Enter' removes the item. That matches the guide's Sources note, but the evidence only confirms 'a mouse click and Enter'. Tap was not verified in the recorded QA. (3) /useWhen/1 ('Keep the empty, preview and unavailable states distinct') restates the core principle. It is accurate but describes how to use the component, not when to choose it. (4) /placementAdvice/0 is correctly 'recommended', not 'required'. The sizing section also allows 'another public layout', and /examples/1 and /examples/2 use HStack and VStack. (5) In /content/good, 'Receipt selected' comes from the live do/don't examples. It may appear in both the Do and the Don't pair. The copy itself is fine, since the problem in the Don't is pairing it with an empty cell.
